mechanism: Disulfiram may inhibit hepatic metabolism of chlorthalidone and both drugs can cause hypokalemia and hyponatremia, increasing electrolyte disturbances and potential cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium and sodium) regularly, assess for signs of hypokalemia, and consider potassium supplementation or alternative diuretic if significant electrolyte depletion occurs.
